collectionMethod: Official Longines Hong Kong listing and one linked product page were opened through the web browsing tool. The tool returned a rendered zh-Hant-HK page and the product page, but indicated the product content was crawled 4 days before retrieval. This is a limited, potentially stale source observation; no complete list or current network response was obtained. No market/history values were inferred or changed.

sourceObservations.rawText: 香港繁體中文 LONGINES HK listing displayed 538 results and the first page of 24 product cards. The visible prices use HK$ formatting and cards show the retailer call to action 尋找零售商. The listing includes a 顯示更多結果 control; no subsequent page was loaded.

sourceObservations.sourceType: official rendered product page linked from the listing
sourceObservations.availabilityInterpretation: The page presents a recommended retail price and a find-a-retailer call to action; no online purchase status inferred.
